title: Task
description: A task as returned by the task service to every client and consumer.

listId.description: The list this task belongs to.

dueAt.description: When the task is due, if it has a due time.

recurrence.description: Repeat rule such as FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=MO. Storage model is undecided.

assigneeId.description: Person the task is assigned to, if any.

nextReminderAt.description: Next scheduled reminder, read from reminders when the task is returned.

version.description: Increments on every saved change; used by sync to detect conflicts.
